sentence: This project builds data and tools for machine learning systems that are built on knowledge maps of cell and tissue architecture.
This project studies how natural products help bacteria on the skin outcompete pathogens and protect the skin.
This project studies how a type of retinal cell cancels signals from self-motion so animals can detect moving objects.
This project tests how deep learning can improve the reading of fetal monitoring during birth and reduce false positives.
This project builds a probing system with dual-color LEDs to study how different regions of organoid disease models communicate.
This project builds a microfluidic device to study how gradients of soluble factors affect zonated functions in liver cells from rodents and humans.
This project tries to find out what lets small-molecule drugs enter Gram-negative bacteria and avoid efflux pumps.
This project builds microscope objective lenses and recovery software that let scientists study RNA and protein distributions in cells without damaging them.
This project tries to find out how to help transferred T cells multiply in place inside solid tumors.
This project tests whether blocking lactate transporters can treat idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis by targeting lactate metabolism.
This project studies how transposable elements in the human genome affect cell function in health and disease.
This project sets up a sterile automated workstation so screening of chemical libraries can use patient-derived samples.
This project studies how breast cancer cells escape natural killer cells, which are innate immune cells that eliminate metastatic cells.
This project studies how the inflammatory microenvironment activates fibroblasts in the synovial lining in rheumatoid arthritis.
This project studies how loss of a lipid transporter changes lipid metabolism and mitochondria in neurons, using human cell models and knockout mice.
This project studies how sleep and circadian disruption change gene expression and cell function in reward circuits, using human samples and rats.
This project develops genome-editing methods to make mouse, rat and Nile rat models for cancer research.
This project tries to find out how best to process blood cells so they can serve as biomarkers that predict response to cancer treatment.
This project studies what controls the bursts of gene activity that Notch signaling produces during development.
This project studies how low excitability in motoneurons contributes to an unstable environment in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.
